answer_1.quote: We propose PrivacyRestore, which directly removes privacy spans in user inputs and restores private information via activation steering during model inference.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs are diagnostic or judgment responses based on user queries in medical and legal domains.

answer_2.quote: For performance evaluation, we use MC1/MC2, ROUGE-L, and LLM-Judge (LLM-J) metrics.

answer_3.quote: We further use the LLM-Judge (LLM-J) metric to assess the generation ability. Specifically, we use the advanced LLM (i.e., GPT-4) to assess the quality of outputs considering relevance, clarity, and accuracy.
